messages.text:
Hello,

I ordered the Magic Miner 40T and i am wondering if is comes with an EU electric plug (two round pins) or only with an US plug?

Thanks for the answer!

Kind regards,

Kevin B.

Hello Kevin,

Good news, it comes with the plug for your region. The cord is matched to the delivery address on your order, so an address in the EU ships with a European cord (the two round pins).

The miner itself is universal: the inlet is a standard IEC C14 and it runs on 100-240V, 50/60Hz. So even if you ever move it to another country, you only swap the cable, not the unit.

If you let me know your order number, I'll double check the address we have on file and confirm the cord that's going in your box.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah,
Thank you for your response.
I live in the Netherlands, the ordernumber is Shop····, i'm sure everything will be fine then!
Kind regards,
Kevin B.

Hello Kevin,

Thanks, I've checked Shop····. It ships to (address hidden), so yes, your 40T comes with a European cord, the two round pins, and the unit is 100-240V so it's a straight plug-in there.

One more thing worth knowing: your order ships from our Netherlands warehouse, so there's no import VAT or customs charge on delivery. Your Magic Miner 40T ships November 21, 2026, together with the Harlo OS Diagnostics package on the same order. You'll get tracking by email as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I was glad to help with this. If you were happy with the service, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com. You're also very welcome in our Discord for setup help and new product news: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah,

Thanks for the update and very nice that there is a warehouse in the Netherlands.
I will certainly check out Discord.

King regards,

Kevin B.

Hello Kevin,

My pleasure. The N. warehouse makes a real difference for orders like yours, delivery is quicker and nothing extra to pay at the door.

See you in the Discord. JD, our hardware guy, is active there as @nullhashrate, so it's a good place to be when your 40T arrives and you're setting it up.

Enjoy the rest of your week, and we'll be in touch with tracking in November.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
